label: pass
title: Checkout total is wrong with a fixed discount code
body:
Checkout shows the wrong total when a fixed discount code is used.

Percent codes look fine.
plan:
Fix Cart.total() so fixed discount codes are applied before tax and totals are clamped to zero. This makes fixed coupons subtract from the subtotal, then tax is computed on the discounted subtotal. Percent discounts are applied before tax as well for consistency.
1. Change Cart.total() to apply discounts before tax and clamp to zero
requirements: Apply fixed discount amount before computing tax (discount reduces subtotal, then tax computed on discounted subtotal).
Percent discounts should be applied before tax (resulting taxed total same as applying after tax but made explicit).
Never return a negative total: clamp final total to at least 0 cents.
Update Cart.total() implementation in src/cart.js only.
Checkout() should continue to use Cart.total() and return receipt.totalCents consistent with the new total calculation.
Behaviour for invalid or absent discounts remains unchanged (no discount).
summary:
Updated Cart.total in src/cart.js to apply discounts before tax and clamp totals to zero. Percent discounts now reduce the subtotal before tax via rounding; fixed discounts subtract from subtotal before tax. Tax is computed on the discounted subtotal and final total is clamped to >= 0. checkout() continues to use Cart.total() and returns receipt.totalCents accordingly. Verified by running npm test: all tests related to cart and server pass; one unrelated pre-existing test (divide by zero) was already failing before the change and remains failing.

Requirements:
1. R1: Applied fixed discount before tax in Cart.total() (src/cart.js: updated total()).
2. R2: Percent discounts applied before tax in Cart.total() (src/cart.js: updated total()).
3. R3: Final total clamped to >= 0 using Math.max(0, taxed) (src/cart.js: updated total()).
4. R4: Only src/cart.js was modified (src/cart.js updated).
5. R5: checkout() still calls Cart.total() and returns receipt.totalCents consistent with new calculation (src/cart.js: checkout() unchanged, uses total()).
6. R6: Behavior for invalid/absent discounts unchanged (no discount) (src/cart.js: if no discount, discountedSubtotal==subtotal).
verify: npm test --silent: exit before=1 after=1; no new test failures
